exhibits.title: The Wheel of Frequencies
exhibits.text: Nested wheels, each turning at its own rate — the SINUSOID family, sin and cos tracing a point around a circle. One sinusoid alone cannot name a position: it returns to the same value every cycle. But stack many frequencies, fast to slow, and together they pin down a unique position — exactly the way second, minute, and hour hands together fix one time. A standard ladder: freq_i = 1/10000^(2i/d), a smooth spread from fast hands to very slow ones. Feed any integer through the family and out comes a fingerprint of rotations, different for every index. Pure trigonometry, turning a bare number into a distinctive code.

exhibits.title: Rotation Preserves Length
exhibits.text: Spin a vector about the origin: its direction changes, its length does not. Rotating [x, y] by φ gives [x·cosφ − y·sinφ, x·sinφ + y·cosφ]; compute the new length and sin² + cos² = 1 cancels everything — unchanged. The meaning: a rotation can carry information in the ANGLE while leaving the magnitude untouched. It is the gentlest transformation there is — reversible and distance-preserving. Above, both arrows keep their exact length however far they swing.

exhibits.title: The Angle-Addition Identity
exhibits.text: cos(A)·cos(B) + sin(A)·sin(B) = cos(A − B). The left side is exactly the DOT PRODUCT of two unit vectors at angles A and B (the Loom next door, with both lengths 1). So alignment depends only on the DIFFERENCE of angles: rotate BOTH vectors by the same extra amount and their dot product does not move. Watch above — the pair swings around the dial together while their mutual angle breathes, and the bar tracks only the gap, ignoring the shared swing entirely.

exhibits.caption: A ladder of frequencies turns a single number into a unique, rich fingerprint — fast and slow hands together.

exhibits.title: Hands of the Wheel, and Angles that Add
exhibits.caption: Left: sinusoids at geometrically spaced frequencies — slow hands that barely turn, fast hands that cycle quickly. No single hand can name a position, but read one index across ALL of them (the dashed line) and the collection of values is unique. Right: rotate by θ, then by φ, and you land exactly where one rotation of θ + φ would put you — length unchanged throughout.

exhibits.title: Where This Leads ↑
exhibits.text: Upstairs, order in a sequence comes from this wheel. ATTENTION is order-blind, so position must be injected: sinusoidal positional encoding runs a token's index through the frequency ladder and ADDS the fingerprint to its embedding. RoPE instead ROTATES each query and key by an angle proportional to position — length preserved, so the content is undistorted, and by the angle-addition identity their dot product sees only RELATIVE distance. DIFFUSION borrows the same wheel to embed the timestep t for its denoiser. One wheel, three costumes.
